detaileddescription.para: Extends the Phase 5 release-gate benchmark suite (benchmarks/network/bench_network_release_gates.cpp NRG-01..NRG-06) with gates for the routing hot paths identified in src/network/ROADMAP.md § Planned Features / Mid-term and § Implementation Phases Phase 4/5.

sect2.title: Gate table
sect2.para:
All benchmarks:
Use kNetworkCanonicalSeed = 42 (per bench_fixtures.h convention).
Run with Repetitions(5).
No live sockets; all I/O is mocked in-process.
UseRealTime() is NOT applied (CPU-only hot paths, no I/O).
